SLocalThetaR03.orthogonal_transport.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F] (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F) (N : Submodule ℂ E) (x : E) :
  (∀ n ∈ N, inner ℂ n x = 0) ↔ ∀ m ∈ Submodule.map (↑U.toLinearEquiv) N, inner ℂ m (U x) = 0
